news.title: William Daley and Paul Ryan Named Chair and Vice Chair of the CSIS Board of Trustees
news.summary_en: The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) today announced the appointment of William Daley, former White House chief of staff and U.S. secretary of commerce, as chair of its board of trustees. Paul Ryan, former speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, has been appointed vice chair.

news.title: Strategic Shores: Strengthening Overseas Port Infrastructure to Safeguard U.S. Economic and Security Interests
news.summary_en: Global seaports have become a key arena for U.S.-China strategic competition. A new CSIS report examines vulnerabilities across the maritime port sector and offers recommendations to strengthen U.S. competitiveness and security overseas.

news.title: Strategic Shores: Strengthening Overseas Port Infrastructure to Safeguard U.S. Economic and Security Interests (Country Case Studies)

news.title: One Year After Busan: Has China Kept Its Rare Earth Promises?
news.summary_en: One year after Busan, China’s rare earth exports to the United States remain sharply below pre-restriction levels, even as global shipments hold steady. Beijing’s continued control over rare earth supplies raises the stakes for Trump-Xi meetings in Shenzhen and Miami.

news.title: Mind the Gap: Keeping Export Compliance Within Reach as BIS Focuses on Enforcement
news.summary_en: The Department of Commerce is emphasizing enforcement of export controls and engaging less with industry. CSIS and UGA experts lay out four steps to keep the resulting compliance burden manageable.
